## What this region is

Transitions as pure data: how to.merge builds the merged record the to side reads, whether a transition can be stored and edited (keyword merges yes, callbacks no), and validateTransition as the authoring check a tenant config passes on save.

## What it exists for

- Turning the proposed changes into the resulting record
- Telling whether a transition can be stored and edited as tenant data
- Checking a tenant-authored transition before it is saved

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- check the change is allowed when the tenant's user clicks approve → lifecycle-guards
- load the relations a tenant predicate reads before checking → lifecycle-guards
- decide which tenant users may approve → transition-authorization
- list every record a tenant's action is open to → lifecycle-guards
